recipe.title: Three Minute Tomato Sauce
ingredients: chilli, with stalks and seeds removed
instructions: Put a pan on full heat and add a lug of oil.
Add the garlic and chilli with stalks and seeds removed.
Add the basil leaves and chopped stalks.
Crush the tomatoes by hand and add them to the pan.
Prepare fresh lasagna sheets or any pasta that you want.
Clean out the tin with a little swig of water and add it to the sauce.
Cook the pasta in starchy water.
Add the cooked pasta to the sauce and toss well.
Add 80 grams of frozen peas, flaked tin tuna (optional), and olives (optional).
Drain the pasta and add it back to the sauce, cooking for the last 30 seconds.
Serve with Parmesan cheese, smaller basil leaves, a kiss of extra virgin olive oil, and feta cheese.
